evidence.text: If there are any risk factors for early-onset neonatal infection (see box 1 on risk- factors for early-onset neonatal infection), or if there are clinical indicators of possible early-onset neonatal infection (see box 2 on clinical indicators of possible early-onset neonatal infection): • perform an immediate clinical assessment • review the maternal and neonatal history • carry out a physical examination of the baby, including an assessment of vital signs. [2021]

claims.text: The unrecorded maternal history and vital signs are normal, so infection has been excluded.

reasons: Claim C1 is not supported by the provided evidence; the guideline excerpt only instructs to perform assessment when risk factors or clinical indicators are present and does not state that normal or unrecorded maternal history and vital signs exclude infection.

Claim C1 asserts infection is excluded because unrecorded maternal history and vital signs are normal, but the patient data shows maternal history is unknown and vital signs are not provided; the guideline evidence only mandates assessment of risk factors and clinical indicators, not that normal/unknown data excludes infection.
